name: Nathan Neal
life: “I still remember sitting beside a client nobody had time to hear.” On Tuesday, near Harbour Bakery, Nathan buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I stayed for breakfast because the woman always eats faster when she thinks we're in a hurry.
appearance: Nathan has a small notch in the left eyebrow. Look for black hair twisted into a small knot. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a dark green knitted vest with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Nathan gives a little nod before asking a hard question.
personality: Nathan finds it easier to own up to a mistake than to accept praise. The worse the mistake, the more precise the account of exactly when it happened.
agenda: To let the client finish breakfast slowly.
family: Daphne Ng is Nathan’s parent’s cousin. Nathan puts the kettle on. Daphne chooses the music. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The other side of the cove*, Daphne says, “I gave the money after selling my second company.”
connections: Ethan Anand (care colleague). The carer who stays for breakfast finally hears the version of the client known on afternoons.

reactions.situation: Two carers turn up for one visit
reactions.response: Nathan asks the client which ordinary task would be easier with two people present.

reactions.response: Nathan offers an ordinary errand that lets the distressed person leave without being followed by an audience.
